artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan adopting FormalSystem.Init across the module tree via 11 minimal-element import edits, fixing the checker's truncated exit status, and wiring it as enforced check C24 with a mandated negative test.

memory_candidates.content: When a repository-wide invariant is 'every module must transitively import root module R', the edit surface is not the number of failing modules but the number of MINIMAL ELEMENTS of the project-internal import DAG (modules with zero intra-project imports). Adding the import to those leaves alone drives the missing count to zero, because every non-leaf reaches a minimal element by following any chain of internal imports. In BimodalLogic this turned a reported 457-module violation into 11 file edits. Two corollaries: (1) sequence the leaf edits low-fan-out first so the mechanism is exercised cheaply before the leaves that invalidate the whole build; (2) edit docstrings in the root module BEFORE adoption, since afterwards every module depends on it and any edit there forces a second full rebuild.
